items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: That band come up the road there. Dejount? That was a bass band.

ctx.x: But I guess when they put a different hole, it's gone. Oh, yeah. They were there, they had a place that was not allowed to pay. They're not allowed to pay all kinds of things. So the people, those kind of people, they'd go in there. You see? At Trans Amis?

Yeah. That's a hole for all. That band come up the road there. Dejount? That was a bass band. Yeah. The rubber show was a bass band. Yeah. They played with this one, they played with this one, not a thing. They had two bands at the same night. Yeah. The crowd was just that heavy, you know. They had two bands, even from the country and the rubber show. Yeah. Yeah. They had a big platform outside and all.

The rubber show, I was small then, I was young then. My brother, they talked about that, it was a rubber show came out there and played. He was being sent in a picture of the home. And Dejount was playing in, I think that called that thing. And I went through with that bandwagon and thought of the thing that he invited. And I got a couple of days ahead. Yeah. Yeah. And Dejount was playing on the other side. Yeah. So Dejount said he's going to keep everybody away from Ruby's show. And Ruby's show said he's going…
